concern: Teach a first-time reader to read a cumulative prebiological dynamical notation, predict intervention outcomes, distinguish passive recurrence from active regulation, and transfer the grammar to an unseen case.
stakeholder: technically curious newcomer with no prior notation training
successCriteria: A first-time reader can identify the next learning action without prior instruction.
After guided practice, the reader can predict an intervention outcome before reveal.
The reader can distinguish passive recurrence from active regulation on an unseen case.
The reader can interpret the learned notation after explanatory scaffolding is removed.
